note: Oracle for forge's §7.1 STRUCTURAL vacuity triage (free/syntactic, no solver). Hand-derived from thermite-design.md §7.1 (R-CHAR-3). `accept` programs must PASS triage (non-vacuous); `reject` programs must be REJECTED with the named structural cause. Triage order: ens-is-trivial (a), ens-omits-result (b), ens-implied-by-req (c), maximal-fx-without-slag (d) — `cause` is the FIRST matching check. Solver tautology/unsat-precondition is #13; mutation is #12 — NOT covered here.

accept.name: corpus_sum
accept.why: sum's contracts are non-vacuous (ens mentions result, not trivially true, not req-implied).

accept.name: corpus_binary_search
accept.why: binary_search's match-ens mentions result and is non-trivial.

accept.name: unit_omits_result_ok
accept.program: fn f(x: u32) -> () ! pure requires true ensures x > 0 { }
accept.why: (b) exempts unit-return fns from must-mention-result (§4.1); ens is non-trivial -> passes (a); not req-implied -> passes (c).

reject.name: ens_is_true
reject.program: fn f() -> () ! pure requires true ensures true { }

reject.name: ens_eq_self
reject.program: fn f(x: u32) -> () ! pure requires true ensures x == x { }
reject.why: (a) ens is an equality with syntactically-identical operands (trivially true).

reject.name: ens_omits_result
reject.program: fn f(x: u32) -> u32 ! pure requires true ensures x > 0 { x }
reject.why: (b) non-unit return but ens does not mention `result` (§4.1).

reject.name: ens_eq_req
reject.program: fn f(x: u32) -> () ! pure requires x > 0 ensures x > 0 { }
reject.why: (c) ens is syntactically identical to req (unit -> (b) does not pre-empt).

reject.name: ens_conjunct_req
reject.program: fn f(x: u32) -> () ! pure requires x > 0 && x < 10 ensures x > 0 { }
reject.why: (c) ens is a conjunct of req's && chain.

reject.name: maximal_fx_no_slag
reject.program:
shared a: u8
fn f(x: u32) -> u32 ! read(a), write(a), net(a), alloc, time, rand, panic, diverge requires true ensures result == x { x }
reject.why: (d) fx row covers all 8 effect kinds and there is no #[slag] justification.
